The backend validates the input and the UI reports the result without showing a success state before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can keep task data accurate without deleting and recreating tasks.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"an existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"the user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its previous title, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"an existing task being edited in the form","when":"the user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend rejects the update, the task keeps its exactly 100 characters and submits the form","then":"the backend stores the new title and returns success"},{"given":"an existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"the user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"the backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns an error","when":"the frontend receives the error response","then":"the frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task update request where the backend returns success","when":"the frontend receives the success response","then":"the frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"a task ID that does
